Discord Rich Presence for AI coding tools, on Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Install

**macOS:** [Download AgentPresence-macOS.dmg](https://github.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/releases/latest/download/AgentPresence-macOS.dmg), open it, double-click **Agent Presence**, click **Install**. Already installed? Open the new app and click **Update**.

**Windows:** [Download AgentPresence-Windows-Setup.exe](https://github.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/releases/latest/download/AgentPresence-Windows-Setup.exe) and run it.

**Linux / macOS terminal**
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/main/install.sh | bash
```
**Windows** (PowerShell)
```
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

## New since v0.9.1

* **Privacy presets.** A new `privacy` setting: `minimal` (just the app and how many agents), `balanced` (the new default) or `full` (everything, as before). Any `show_*` switch you set yourself still wins.
* **Private repos stay private on Discord.** In `balanced`, only repos that are public on GitHub are named. Everything else shows as "private project", with no branch line.
* **No file names by default.** `show_files` is now off. Even when it's on, secret-looking names (`.env`, `id_rsa`, `*.pem`, `secrets.*`…) are never shown.
* **Linked computers are encrypted on your network.** Their status packets used to be signed but readable by anyone on the same Wi-Fi; now they're encrypted too. **Update all your linked computers together**, since older versions can't read the new packets.
* **Your config is owner-only.** `config.json`, which can hold your GitHub token, and the app's state folder are now readable only by you.
* **The Mac app asks for a fine-grained GitHub token** that can only write your profile repo, instead of quietly using your GitHub CLI login (which can write to all your repos).
* **Agents in WSL now show on Windows.** Claude Code and Codex running inside WSL were missed, so the card said idle. Their logs are now read from each running distro.

**Upgrading:** your Discord card will show less than before. To keep the old card, add `"privacy": "full"` to `~/.config/ai-presence/config.json`.
